title: A common local stalk model on one connected component
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, B a Noetherian commutative coefficient ring, z a point of X, and K a bounded complex over the constant B-ring on the coefficient-sized etale model with finite locally constant cohomology in every degree. If U is a coefficient-sized pro-etale object whose image is contained in the connected component of z, there exists a covering sieve S on U such that, for every arrow V to U in S, the actual-slice restriction to V of the comparison pullback of K is isomorphic to the slice restriction of the derived constant realization of the specified geometric stalk K at X.algClosurePoint(z). The ringed derived categories, comparison and restriction are [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons], and the stalk is [def-sfb-coefficient-etale-derived-stalk]. No Tor amplitude, affineness, or weak contractibility hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Obtain an etale chart through every point, together with its individual algebraic derived model, the identifications of all geometric stalks on its image, and its comparison realization on every pro-etale object factoring through the chart. Different charts need not yet have isomorphic models.

source.place: Tag 09BI, proof through the common model, before its perfectness conclusion; sites-cohomology.tex lemma-locally-constant

proof.text: Let G be the set of points whose specified derived stalk is isomorphic to the specified derived stalk at z. Etale chart images are open. A chart meeting G lies in G, by composing its stalk identifications; a chart meeting the complement lies in the complement by the same calculation. Thus both G and its complement are open. Mathlib IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union, applied to the connected component of z and its point z in G, shows that the whole component lies in G. This is the proved private helper stalks_agree_on_component.

source.place: Tag 09BI, proof through the common model, before its perfectness conclusion; sites-cohomology.tex lemma-locally-constant

proof.text: For every point x of the underlying test object U, pull back the chart chosen at its image to U. These are etale arrows over U and jointly surjective: choose a point of that chart over the image of x and use Mathlib Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback. Hence this is an etale covering family and therefore a pro-etale covering family. Transport its generated sieve through AsSmall.equiv using functorPushforward_mem_iff. Empty U is covered by the same argument with empty index type.

source.place: Tag 09BI, proof through the common model, before its perfectness conclusion; sites-cohomology.tex lemma-locally-constant

proof.text: An arrow in the generated sieve factors through a chosen pullback chart. Compose that factorization with the projection to the original etale chart and apply its atlas comparison isomorphism. The image hypothesis identifies the specified stalk at z with the stalk at the chosen image point. Compose this with the inverse of the chart model identification, map it through the derived constant functor and the slice restriction, and compose with the atlas comparison isomorphism.

theorem coefficient_connected_local_stalk_models
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (z : X) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (himage : Set.range
      (((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj U).hom.base) ⊆
        connectedComponent z)
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q →
      IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ConstantCompletion.Mod
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X U ∧
      ∀ (V : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
        Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
            ((commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor.{max v (u + 1), max v (u + 1),
              max v (u + 1), max v (u + 1) + 1}
              (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B).obj
              ((coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk X B (X.algClosurePoint z)).obj K)) ≅
          (adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
            ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X B).obj K))
